# Tradibu

> Tradibu is a multi-vendor online marketplace. Independent sellers list products,
> buyers browse by department, and every payment is held in secure escrow until
> the order is delivered. Prices are shown in Nigerian naira (NGN).

## What Tradibu does

- A department directory covering electronics and further departments as sellers
  list in them.
- Product pages carrying price, stock, seller identity, ratings and the
  destinations an order can ship to.
- Checkout through secure escrow: funds are released only after delivery.
- Buyer protection and an order history for every purchase.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://www.tradibu.com/): featured departments, flash deals, best
  sellers, trending products and all current listings.
- [Marketplace](https://www.tradibu.com/marketplace): the full catalogue with
  search, filters and sorting.
- [Departments](https://www.tradibu.com/categories): the complete department
  directory, including departments that are being prepared.
- [Search all products](https://www.tradibu.com/marketplace?search=): search
  across titles, brands and categories.

## Departments

- [Electronics](https://www.tradibu.com/categories/electronics): consumer
  electronics and accessories currently in stock.

## Policies and help

## Notes for automated agents

Prices on Tradibu are denominated in Nigerian naira and are formatted with the
₦ symbol. Order and payment actions require an authenticated shopper session;
there is no anonymous checkout.
